documents.summary: Proposed rules for evidence-grounded Summary, Guide, and tag annotations on a changed document, including source revisions, existing-tag reuse, provenance, and protection of source text.
documents.guide: Use when proposing metadata for an added or updated document. Read Review & Change Policy before applying any proposal; metadata generation does not establish indexing readiness.

documents.summary: Proposed rules for seven supported relationship kinds, direction, explicit-reference evidence, local candidate discovery, duplicate prevention, and review of conflicts or removals.
documents.guide: Use when selecting relationship kinds and resolving source and target documents. An explicit reference may qualify for automatic addition only after every change-policy gate passes.

documents.summary: Proposed local-change policy defining automatic application, human review, blocked or stale outcomes, protected data, atomic writes, revision checks, idempotency, and producer provenance.
documents.guide: Read before routing or applying any Curator proposal. If any operation needs review, preserve the whole pending change set for review; approval cannot bypass technical validation or grant wider scope.

relations.description: Metadata Guidelines explicitly links Relationship Guidelines as a companion policy.
Metadata Guidelines explicitly delegates application eligibility to Review & Change Policy.
Relationship Guidelines explicitly links Metadata Guidelines for grounded annotations.
Relationship Guidelines explicitly links Review & Change Policy for application safeguards.
Review & Change Policy explicitly governs proposals made under Metadata Guidelines.
Review & Change Policy explicitly governs proposals made under Relationship Guidelines.
